ENABLED% is implemented CLI commands bound to source operations, never inventory count or declared coverage.
Missing typed contracts, commands and sync-transport definitions are declaration-pending, not foundation gaps.
Complete source-locked endpoint map. Every documented operation has one primary endpoint class: direct_read, direct_write, etl, binary_read, or binary_write.
